glosses: anyone, anybody, anyone at all, anybody at all, any person

examples.text: Der Mann ist nicht irgendjemand.
Irgendjemand spricht mit dein Vater.
Kann mir irgendjemand beim Abspülen helfen?
Irgendjemand muss die Verantwortung übernehmen.
„Er hat gelernt, dass er keine Ursache hat, sich über irgendetwas oder über irgendjemanden erhaben zu fühlen.“
„Aber irgendjemand muss die Hunderte Rechnungen überweisen, die Unterlagen für den Steuerberater vorbereiten, die Mahnungen schreiben, schlicht, den ganzen Papierkram bewältigen.“
„Aber das hätte er nie irgendjemandem gegenüber zugegeben.“

glosses: One or some person of unspecified or indefinite identity.

examples.text: Can someone help me, please?
Can you get me someone more knowledgeable?

glosses: A partially specified but unnamed person.

examples.text: Do you need a gift for that special someone?

His ultimate concern is with being and beings, with saying something about something and not with the someones who say it and hear it—and not even with the someones whose beings are in conflict about beings in their being.
It had never happened, it wasn't that there hadn't been any 'someones', there had actually been numerous 'someones', but not one that had gotten between him and his work.

Or rather, to someone. Many someones, in fact. But which someones? Well, the someones that benefited while wage controls were in place had to be people for whom salary was not the primary form of income.
He thinks he has become someone.
Somebody has to clean this mess up.
So there, I know, was somebody or a combination of somebodys who did not know what the heck they were doing or dealing with.

glosses: A recognised or important person, a celebrity.

examples.text: I'm tired of being a nobody – I want to be a somebody.

glosses: Indica un numero indeterminato ma solitamente ristretto di cose o persone, che può essere costituito anche da una sola unità; ha soltanto la forma del sing.

examples.text: qualcuno di voi
mi servono dei fiammiferi dammene qualcuno

glosses: personalità affermata in termini di status, p.es. prestigio sociale, notorietà, competenza

examples.text: In een urinoir kan het ook soms moeilijk zijn om met iemand naast je te plassen.

glosses: obecné, neurčité označení osoby: nějaký člověk

examples.text: Někdo přišel. To se někdo má!
On je prostě někdo!
